name: Eevee
DexDescription: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates to fit its environment. Radiation from various stones causes it to evolve.
evolution_text: Eevoleon (Loyalty 5), Vaporeon (Water Stone), Jolteon (Thunder Stone), Flareon (Fire Stone), Espeon (Dawn Stone), Umbreon (Moon Stone), Leafeon (Leaf Stone), Glaceon (Ice Stone), Sylveon (Shiny Stone), Noxeon (*Toxin Stone), Orreon (*Precious Stone), Champeon (*Brave Stone), Dusteon (*Desert Rose), Papilleon (*Amber Onyx), Mummeon (Dusk Stone), Nimbeon (*Feather Stone), Glaveon (*Adamantite Stone), Drakeon (*Rune Stone).

name: Noxeon
DexDescription: Upon evolving from exposure to a rare poisonous mineral. It gained the ability to create gaseous vapours that are highly toxic.

name: Orreon
DexDescription: Orreon grew odd mineral based protrusions on its form when it evolved, sprouting a pair of rocky horns. The horns often break during combat, but regrow over time.

name: Champeon
DexDescription: Champeon has a dauntless spirit, no matter how many times it gets beaten down, it will refuse to give up. The older and more experienced this Pokémon gets, the more scars it has.

name: Dusteon
DexDescription: It wanders the desert, often guiding lost travellers. People who live in locations where this Pokémon resides have long associated it with dust devils and sand storms.

name: Papilleon
DexDescription: It's wing like ears and antennae pick up the slightest vibrations in air currents, allowing it to fight almost blind.

name: Mummeon
DexDescription: This mummified Pokémon is said to curse anyone who looks into its Unown eye. It appears on ancient hieroglyphs in temples throughout the world.

name: Nimbeon
DexDescription: Nimbeon summons clouds, its body is almost weightless. Some ancient religions believe Nimbeon to be the messengers of gods.

name: Glaveon
DexDescription: Glaveon's body turned into a malleable metal when it evolved. The glaive like tail, claws and teeth remain as hard as tempered steel though.

name: Drakeon
DexDescription: Drakeon's diamond hard scales glisten in an array of dazzling colors in the light. Legend has it that these magical scales have the power to work miracles.

name: Eevoleon
DexDescription: Eevoleon, was discovered recently. This evolution of Eevee seems to have a completely stabilized DNA. It can harness the power of the entire type spectrum.

name: Okidogi (Kantonian Form)
DexDescription: Okidogi is lazy slightly useless, but it has a chill demeanour. It is known to partake in a little roadside banditry of travelling merchants along the forested paths of its home.

name: Fezandipiti (Kantonian Form)
DexDescription: Fezandipiti is vain and impulsive. It is always preening and cleaning its plumage in an attempt to make itself look more beautiful.

name: Munkidori (Kantonian Form)
DexDescription: Munkidori is cheeky and conniving, it likes to play pranks on people and Pokémon with its latent psychic powers. It’s tricks often backfire due to it not being the smartest.

name: Owlperra
DexDescription: Owlperra are often used by noble families to protect and care for their children. It is also not unheard of for them to be used as assistants by doctors or healers.

name: Klefki (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It collects small sharp objects such as knives and thrown weapons. It's temperament is nasty, though the right Trainer can win its hard won affection.

name: Ralts (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: The Johtonian form of Ralts lives in oceanic caves. It's shell like helmet slips down over its eyes often.

name: Kirlia (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It's clear bioluminescent frills are made of a similar substance to the bodies of Jellicent and Tentacruel. It dances in the shallows as it hones its powers.

name: Gallade (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It's gel like fins have hard cartilage inside, the edges are sharp and can cause nasty wounds if it slices with them. The gel contains a stinging toxin that can be lethal if left untreated. Its a fast swimmer and fast on land too.

name: Gardevoir (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: Known as the witch of the sea, this semi aquatic Pokémon is a powerful psychic, able to create whirlPools and vortexes with its powers. It is known to sink ships if it believes it has been slighted by their crew.

name: Tinkatink (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It's body seems to be a gel like exterior coating the skeleton. It carries with it a stone blade made of chipped flint.

name: Tinkatuff (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: Having evolved it now manifests a ghostly edge to its stone blade. It silently works on its swordsmanship all throughout the night.

name: Tinkaton (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: The blade glows with a baleful blue light, its edge honed to an impossibly sharp edge. Some say it is able to cut the fabric of reality itself when it swings it.

name: Gothita (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It imitates human royalty, often decorating and adorning itself with flowers and trinkets, though these often weigh it down making it clumsy.

name: Gothorita (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It believes itself to be a princess, it has been known to spend up to 8 hours a day staring at its own reflection. It slaps those its dislikes with its long sleeve like arms.

name: Gothitelle (Johtonian Form)
DexDescription: It is vain and standoffish, fully believing itself to be royalty. It bosses around other weaker Pokémon as if they where servants.

name: Streagle
DexDescription: Streagle has a greater grasp on many artistic methods then it did as a Smeargle and as such its artistic abilities have improved greatly.

name: Collosoar
DexDescription: It soars through the clouds, filtering micro-organisms from the cloud layer. The raiders of Ancient Fyrun are said to ride them through the sky.

name: Admirmimic
DexDescription: Admirmimic are often used by sailors to convey messages across large vessels. Owning an  Admirmimic is seen as a sign of Status among pirate captains, and they are normally taught many crude sayings.

name: Heatmega
DexDescription: It fights fiercely against Durengine. They are mortal enemies, as Heatmega's favourite food is Durant. A Durant nest without a Durengine will fall quickly to H eatmega's ravenous hunger.

name: Durengine
DexDescription: It is only found usually where a nest has many Heatmor or a Heatmega preying on it. Heatmor will think twice before fighting a Durengine.

name: Hoppip (Unovan Form)
DexDescription: It is known to produce a strange powder from the leaves on its head that cause sleep.

name: Skiploom (Unovan Form)
DexDescription: The flower on top of its head releases a somniferous pollen. This property is used in narcotics.

name: Jumpluff (Unovan Form)
DexDescription: The pollen from its limbs causes powerful drowsiness that eventually knock out its opponents. It flies lowly in the evening, hunting for people's dreams.

name: Mieneira
DexDescription: It sees fighting as a dance, unfortunately its partners never live up to its expectations.

name: Swablu (Unovan Form)
DexDescription: Swablu is known to create localized micro storms. It's soft downy feathers hold a strong ionic charge.

name: Altaria (Unovan Form)
DexDescription: Altaria make their homes in high peaks and take to the sky during storms.

name: Paras (Kalosian Form)
DexDescription: The strange glowing mushrooms that call this Pokémon home, have imbued it with psionic power. The symbiotic relationship between the parasite and the host is a strange one. From the time it hatches Paras is always infected.

name: Parasect (Kalosian Form)
DexDescription: The colony of mushrooms on Parasect's back produce a dull bioluminescence. Waving its claws it can manipulate objects with psionic power, crushing them with a force of 180 PSI.

name: Pawniard (Kalosian Form)
DexDescription: Though it is small it has a huge superiority complex. Often refusing to fight opponents it deems unworthy of its skills.

name: Bisharp (Kalosian Form)
DexDescription: Its tactical knowledge has developed as it has grown. It is an expert at hand to hand combat. Many a castle has owed a successful defense to the Bisharp that fought alongside the soldiers.

name: Lancieknight
DexDescription: It lives by a knightly code of chivalry, though it still has airs of superiority. Its battle prowess are second to none.

name: Hatenna (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It burbles and hums to itself, while bobbing atop the waves. Water that Hatenna is found in is often said to be the purest in the world.

name: Hattrem (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It’s singing voice has improved greatly after evolution. The melodies it creates are very soothing.

name: Hatterene (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It is said that its voice has the power to control and influence others. It is deeply protective of the waters it calls home.

name: Centirage
DexDescription: It lost its fiery abilities upon evolving into this form. Now It stalks as a solitary predator. Anything that disturbs it will feel the wrath of its imperious rage.

name: Elekid (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It whirls its arms like a dynamo creating a charge, when it creates a spark it can turn them into small explosions that burn with a bright yellow fire.

name: Electabuzz (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It feasts from striking lighting, which it converts into energy. It's abilities have grown stronger since evolving.

name: Electivire (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It's reckless and has a short temper. Blue bolts of lighting spark off of its beard and fire burns from its arms if it gets agitated.

name: Cruskull
DexDescription: It's visage has often been a cause of fright among travellers to distant shores. Despite its crab like appearance it tends to prefer to live above the tide line, it has been known to climb coconut trees.

name: Crabramuerte
DexDescription: It is a vicious fighter and fiercely territorial. It has been known to clear out beaches during the evening when it begins to become active.

name: Sandile (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It lives in swampy tropical rivers. It plays in the mud near the river banks. It keeps a constant bubble over each of its eyes which keep them clean and improve its vision under water.

name: Krokorok (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: Its murky coloration helps it blend into the waters and river banks of its home.

name: Krookodile (Alolan Form)
DexDescription: It is the monarch of its patch of estuary. It lounges on the banks sunning itself. Smaller Pokémon try to keep on its good side by bringing it food and trinkets.

name: Voltorb (Galarian Form)
DexDescription: Highly dangerous and prone to exploding at random. If you see the wick like protrusion catch aflame, run! When it explodes it spreads its seeds.

name: Electrode (Galarian Form)
DexDescription: It has a short fuse in both senses of the phrase. They are often employed during sieges by careful saboteurs. Though often this ends up being more detrimental to those using them than the enemy.

name: Scraggy (Galarian Form)
DexDescription: It often trips on its tails. It has a jovial nature but is always happy to throw down if it needs too.

name: Scrafty (Galarian Form)
DexDescription: It tends to boss around those it considers its underlings. When it fights it holds its fist like a true pugilist.

name: Chimaooze
DexDescription: Chimaooze is a strange ooze like Pokémon often found in rubbish dumps, middens and sewers. In small numbers they are not too dangerous but when they swarm they can become a plague on a town or settlement. Raiding food stores and causing illness. The ooze its body is made of is incredibly toxic to most other living things. It's rumoured that when many Chimaooze gather a king emerges as they combine into one giant form.

name: Phlask
DexDescription: Laboratory glassware possessed by a playful but frightening spirit. It is known to spew chemicals onto random objects to see what happens.
evolution_text: Medium (Holding either Ice Heal or Burn Heal)

name: Noxial (Endothermic Form)
DexDescription: Noxial have been discovered in both endothermic and exothermic forms. The more extreme the temperature, the more volatile the Noxial.

name: Noxial (Exothermic Form)
DexDescription: Noxial have been discovered in both endothermic and exothermic forms. The more extreme the temperature, the more volatile the Noxial.

name: Fumighast
DexDescription: Within Fumighast are residual chemicals from its time as a Noxial. Using them as catalysts, Fumighast can recreate spontaneous, volatile Reactions at will.

name: Fauxeary
DexDescription: Appearing amidst the laughter of children and the warmth of homes, it seeks love, though often does not receive it due to its rather scary appearance.

name: Fauxpunny
DexDescription: Fauxpunny evolves from Fauxeary due to the profound connection shared with a human companion. Its evolution reflects the thoughts and emotions of those it bonds with, resulting in a form resembling that of a real Lopunny.

name: Maesquito
DexDescription: Swarms of Maesquito fly through the skies on summer evenings, the leader conducts the others in a deafening symphony.

name: Cracolite
DexDescription: Cracolite makes its home on chilly shores. In the summer it digs down deep beneath the sand to wait out the hot Weather.

name: Crustamancer
DexDescription: Beaches with well kept dunes are usually home to Crustamancer. They painstakingly sculpt the sand into interesting patterns somewhat like a zen garden.

name: Axew (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It obsessively chips and sharpens the flint like protrusions that grow from its face. They grow at a very fast rate and if not chipped down can pose a threat to Axew's health.

name: Fraxure (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It has an angry temperament, and will but heads with other Pokémon and people in its territory.

name: Haxorus (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It is very strong, its tail and horns are made of a flint like material nearly as hard as steel. If they get chipped or Damaged they regrow very fast.

name: Capsighoul
DexDescription: This elusive Pokémon roams fields at night, leaving behind a faint ghost of a spicy aroma. Its presence is known to enhance the spiciness of nearby peppers.

name: Capsiwisp (Hydrated Form)
DexDescription: Its presence not only enhances the spiciness of nearby peppers but also ignites them with unprecedented intensity, resulting in people developing a high tolerance for spice due to its influence in the fields.

name: Capsiwisp (Dessicated Form)
DexDescription: Capsiwisp seeks to absorb life force to satiate itself. Encounters with Capsiwisp induce a sense of unease, as if one's life force is slowly sapped away by its presence. Legends speak of Capsiwisp as a harbinger of barren fields.

name: Arachdii
DexDescription: It burrows underground to sleep, when it senses vibrations nearby it emerges, leaping into the air and pouncing on its prey.

name: Arachdriia
DexDescription: It carves out large underground tunnel systems it uses as nests and larders for its captured food.

name: Roggenrola (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It is made from compressed rock, though its core is roiling molten magma.

name: Boldore (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Boldore lives in deep dark caves. Even on the stone of the depths its feet leave the ground scorched and smoking. If it stays in one place to long it can begins to melt through the floor.

name: Gigalith (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Steam vents from the obsidian protrusions on its body. It drinks from lava flows in its volcanic home, energising it.

name: Carvanha (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Where there was once ocean, now there is desert. Carvanha still swims through its home, now sand dunes as if they where waves.

name: Sharpedo (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It's glowing baleful red eyes are often the last thing an unweary traveller in the desert sees after feeling the sands rumble beneath them.

name: Peckabone
DexDescription: It is vindictive and temperamental, it hops around still unable to fly long distances yet. It feasts of carrion when it finds it.

name: Rexquiem
DexDescription: It is a carrion eater, known colloquially known as the desert reaper.  When night falls and the air chills it silently glides through the night above the sands looking for the dead.

name: Heracross (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It's iridescent wings sparkle with the colors of the rainbow. In the arid regions it calls home, they are often encouraged into gardens by nobility as a sign of Status due to their beautiful jewelled carapace.

name: Pinsir (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Pinsir's horns have a crushing power next to no other, it can crush solid stone between them. The buzzing from its wings can reach an ear splitting cacophony during summer.

name: Hawlucha (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It calls rocky canyons home, where it leaps and glides within them. It always seeks to better its performance in battle, endlessly practising new Moves and techniques.

name: Magikarp (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Found in a large underground lake in the Orrelborous region during a mining survey. Despite its body being partly made of rock it is a lot of a better swimmer than its other form.

name: Gyarados (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It can be found in deep underground lakes and waterfalls. It’s crystalline protrusions glow with a bright bioluminescence. It’s temper is somehow even worse than the standard form.

name: Spiritomb (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: A ghost in the machine, it inhabits this ancient electronic device. Rumour has it that it appeared when 108 people passed on a certain cursed chain email.

name: Bowllo
DexDescription: Bowllo is often mistaken for a ball when it curls up on the ground. It's typically found in desert and scrubland areas.

name: Dupedillo
DexDescription: Dupedillo is great at digging, and its tough claws aid it in battle. It still is more likely to curl up then choose to fight most opponents though.

name: Zhusk
DexDescription: Zhusk are actually a collection of smaller individual Pokémon united by a common goal of wanderlust. In a pinch they can launch members of the colony at foes.

name: Maizemen
DexDescription: The many minds of the colony work in tandem, the older the colony the more minds they have. Some Mayzmen have been recorded at over 10ft tall.

name: Macrabra
DexDescription: Inside the shell of Macrabra is an intricate system of chambers that it can use to hide in. They also resonate sound in curious ways, instruments made from them are often quite sought after.

name: Frogersage
DexDescription: Frogersage floats through the sky on its cloud of bubbles or rests by mountain streams. It is lazy by nature but myths about it say it is supposedly wise.

name: Spectrelec (Kabutops Form)
DexDescription: Vengeful spirits possessed fossils at a dig site! Sometimes that which is buried best remains that way.

name: Spectrelec (Aerodactyl Form)
DexDescription: Vengeful spirits possessed fossils at a dig site! Sometimes that which is buried best remains that way.

name: Gigalanche
DexDescription: Gigalanche Moves with the slow and sturdy nature of a glacier, small clouds have formed around the peaks on its mountainous frame.

name: Dunboros
DexDescription: Some say the region of Orrelborous was formed by a giant Dunboros. It does not seem to intake any nutrients, gaining all it needs from its own tail apparently.

name: Garbocean
DexDescription: Garbocean was bio-engineered in a lab to help clean the ocean of trash off the coasts of Orre and Orrelborous.

name: Eruptoise
DexDescription: Many famous hot springs have Eruptoise living near by, the waters can reach exceedingly high temperatures where they congregate.

name: Pansnear
DexDescription: Pansnear, lurks in the darkness of dense forests, using its sharp instincts and keen hearing, it stalks its prey, though not to eat, only to play pranks on.

name: Simisnear
DexDescription: It is said that wherever Similar appears, misfortune follows, as it has a habit of manipulating shadows to mislead travellers and cause chaos.

name: Panstrike
DexDescription: Known for its powerful fists and lightning-fast reflexes, Panstrike thrives in combat, often seen sparring with other wild Pokémon to sharpen its skills.

name: Simistrike
DexDescription: It leads with courage and determination, inspiring other Pokémon around it by emitting an aura of fierce intensity that grows stronger the more it battles.

name: Panpsych
DexDescription: When threatened, Panpsych releases a powerful psychic pulse that can disorient foes, leaving them momentarily unable to tell reality from illusion.

name: Simipsych
DexDescription: Known for its eerie calmness, Simipsych can communicate telepathically with those it trusts, sharing visions and thoughts directly into their minds.

name: Budew (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Having to suddenly adapt to the desert climate lead to Budew drying out and barely surviving. It hides itself in the dunes and scrubland of its new home, hiding from predators.

name: Roselia (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Roselia has begun to find its place in its new environment. It carries the desert with it now, wearing a veil of sand.

name: Roserade (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Now predator instead of prey, Roserade hunts during sandstorms. It cloaks itself with billowing sand and is able to control its surroundings fully.

name: Arcanine (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Having adapted to the colder climate of the mountain peaks it calls home. It looks down upon the region in its majesty. It's sow white fur is engulfed in flame.

name: Dragonite (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It lives near large lakes and rivers. Often locally known as a guardian or spirit of the water itself.

name: Chinchou (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It uses its strange baleful lights to lure prey, it lives in the deep ocean where no natural light reaches.

name: Lanturn (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It is said that they use their lights to lure sailors overboard to a watery grave.

name: Blackbrish
DexDescription: It stays with its parents for a long time, while its glass like body slowly toughens. They communicate through a complex series of ink sprays.

name: Orcquill
DexDescription: It lives far out to sea, its glass like body polished to dull lustre by the ocean waves. Though strong, it usually sprays ink and escapes rather than engaging in battle.

name: Skarmory (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: The colorful plumage of its tail is used to attract a mate. It's carapace gleams, and Skarmory flying during sunny days are known to be eye watering sun strike.

name: Toxtricity (Orrean Smouldering Form)
DexDescription: It burns the poison in its body, and spews out toxic fumes as it attacks. This same technique can be used to create great belching raspy noises, akin to the singers from heavy metal bands. It is known as the smouldering form.

name: Jangmo-o (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Their fangs are laced with a toxin that is not very powerful, but it is enough to slow prey down and disorient them for it to catch up to them. Many joke that this toxin is connected to their mean personality.

name: Hakamo-o (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Hakamo-o are actually quadrupedal, but stand up during battle for intimidation and flexibility. Their main fighting plan is to rush in and swing about wildly until something goes down.

name: Kommo-o (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: As the apex predator of their habitat, they've grown in size and developed a toxin strong enough to cause fainting. It uses the scent of this toxin to track down prey that escaped an assault.

name: Milotic (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Beautiful and highly dangerous it is seen as a Status symbol among the wealthy. The poison it exudes is potent enough to kill an adult human in under a minute.

name: Sewaddle (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Driven into a corner by increasing urbanisation, this Sewaddle started turning its leaves into shapes resembling more of a skull to scare off any unwanted predators.

name: Swadloon (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Using its silhouette to ward off enemies, it prefers hiding in darker spots where visibility isn't as high. It's prone to attacking anyone that gets too close while its eating.

name: Leavanny (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It is fiercely protective of smaller Pokémon, but avoids conflict if possible and will try to intimidate predators instead. The leaves on Leavanny's arms are razor sharp.

name: Porygon 3
DexDescription: Porygon 2 where upgraded to serve as satellites for a certain augmented reality project, based in Duskfork city.

name: Spidream
DexDescription: It is said that you will have sweet dreams if Spidream make their webs around your house. Research suggests that Spidream inspired the design of Dream Catchers.

name: Nightmarach
DexDescription: They can manipulate the dreams of people and Pokémon by tugging on the threads they hold. The silk they produce is known to induce slumber.

name: Ms. Mime
DexDescription: This Pokémon is known for its wild dizziness inducing performances, where it flips through the air. It is thought to have inspired circus harlequins.

name: Torribul
DexDescription: In ancient times this Pokémon was often used to guard people of importance or treasures. In close quarters combat it is unmatched.

name: Minomega
DexDescription: Myths surrounded Minomega, one such myth details a labyrinth guarded by this Pokémon, a hero is said to have used thread find his way to the treasure at the heart of the maze.

name: Tydra
DexDescription: This small Pokémon was thought to be long extinct, but recently reports have surfaced of sightings in a large lake in the Orrelborous region.

name: Hydrench
DexDescription: An ancient myth states that a hero fought Hydrench and managed to cut off its head, but he was then struck down and killed by it when it grew two more.

name: Hydroon
DexDescription: It is said to live at the bottom of Gemburst lake. Many sightings have been claimed over the years, but none have ever been confirmed.

name: Flariny
DexDescription: Flariny where originally thought to be demons in ancient times. They congregate around those with darkness in their hearts, finding small ways to punish them.

name: Infury
DexDescription: Legends surround Infury, it was thought that it would carry to the souls of evil people to torment eternal in the afterlife.

name: Frigilett
DexDescription: It's warm feathery pelt is the perfect camouflage for the snowy mountains and tundra it calls home. It is prized by poachers and hunters.

name: Tungryph
DexDescription: The ultimate hunter, it is a master of the cold skies. It is a noble Pokémon, and there are stories of ancient heroes riding them into battle.

name: Drifloon (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Using their chain like appendages Drifloon attach themselves to the sea floor. Hitting the spikes on their bodies will cause them to often explode. Overnight it reconstructs its body.

name: Drifblim (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: They can be found sleeping in large groups underwater, it is best not to wake them. If one is spotted, the coast guard enforce a strict cordon around the area until they can be safely Moved.

name: Trapinch (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

name: Flygon (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

name: Pirouby
DexDescription: It dances in graceful Movements as it spins its web. Appearing innocent it attracts its prey.

name: Fataletta
DexDescription: During its mating season many Pirouby follow it. If it doesn't like one of them, it eats it.

name: Hatenna (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Hatenna learns from its extended family or coven. It is cheeky and vindictive, and often feuds with Impidimp.

name: Hattrem (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Hattrem is a talented healer, and adept with its mystical powers. It tends to the dark forests it calls home.

name: Haggerene
DexDescription: In the forests where Haggerene live there are often strange phenomena such as natural barriers made of twisting thorns. The local populations of other forest dwelling Pokémon pay them tribute and in return Haggerene treats them when they are sick.

name: Impidimp (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Impidimp gather on the corner of roofs, leering and glaring at passers by. There have recently been a number of number of incidents in Neo Elysium, where they have thrown roof tiles at people they don’t like.

name: Morgrem (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: They prefer to make their home on older buildings, where they can blend in better with the masonry. They hunt bird Pokémon and vermin.

name: Grimmgoyle
DexDescription: It rules the rooftops of the city, though it hardly ever enters combat. When it does however, it just turns invisible and beats its opponents without breaking a sweat.

name: Voodoll
DexDescription: Ceremonial dolls possessed by the vengeful spirits they where once used to channel. They like to corrupt troubled children, encouraging them to inflict harm on others.

name: Voodoom
DexDescription: Using powerful sorcery they are said to curse, those who have wronged them, channelling the spirits of powerful practitioners from beyond the grave.

name: Cubzier
DexDescription: A native of the far off Pachir region. It's body can switch between solid or gas at will. It is often seen at temples where the scent of its incense fills the air.

name: Bengaroma
DexDescription: Despite its predator like look, it is very friendly and affectionate. It's known to be a very lazy Pokémon, Most likely seen dozing somewhere in a sunbeam.

name: Hoothoot (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Hoothoots tail appears to look like a view into space itself, many have attempted to decipher if it is a view into known parts of the cosmos.

name: Noctowl (Orrean Form)
DexDescription: Legend has it that when Noctowl takes flight in the evening, causing night to fall over the land, trailing from its tail feathers.

name: Budew (Islas Lluvia De’estrellas Form)
DexDescription: The original native Orrelboroun species of Budew, they can now only be found on the Islas Lluvia De'estrellas. They are often hidden away in the deepest parts of forest, fast asleep. They only wake up when they need sunlight. Their skin is very tough and its spiked hair can feel metallic.

name: Roselia (Islas Lluvia De’estrellas Form)
DexDescription: When Budew managed to control its sleepwalking it evolves into Roselia. They do almost everything while asleep, so they can often wander away from their original home. When they detect enemies nearby, they wake up and swiftly run away back home.

name: Roserade (Islas Lluvia De’estrellas Form)
DexDescription: Masters of awareness, this kind of Roserade spend 22 Hours sleeping per day. They utilise piercing attacks and their precision is unmatched while they are asleep. They only wake up to reposition themselves under the sunlight of the sub-tropical forests they call home.

name: Faerry
DexDescription: Faerry gives off a soothing aroma that calms even the most aggressive Pokémon. Its petals shimmer in the sunlight. It blooms in response to emotional energy, glowing brighter in the presence of joy and love. Faerry’s petals are prized for their calming effects, and it is often associated with celebrations and festivals.

name: Clayngel
DexDescription: Used as a Weapon of war by the ancient people that created it. It's 360 degree vision allows it to never be snuck up on.

name: Stontitan
DexDescription: Stontitan is thought to be a gateway to other worlds, it draws its odd powers from those other places.

name: Sigileye
DexDescription: It's gaze can hypnotise those that look at it. It guards ancient places of power and worship.

name: Magnework
DexDescription: It's body seems to be powered by a form of clockwork. Strong magnetic fields wind the strange gears its insides are comprised of.

name: Bronzelord
DexDescription: The sonorous tones from its bell like body are said to be able to heal those who are sick.

name: Aileyahn
DexDescription: Some say it came from space, but the markings on its body resemble those found on ancient ruins and other strange ancient Pokémon.

name: Hystearic
DexDescription: In the deep dark old forests it calls home, wailing can be heard from Hystearic. If anything goes wrong for it, it breaks down in tears.

name: Wystearia
DexDescription: Even having evolved it still throws tantrums, however it lashes out at those who annoy it rather then wailing.

name: Skyphozoa
DexDescription: It floats in the troposphere gaining ionic charge as storms form. It discharges this electrical energy from its tentacles, using them to stun and ensnare prey. When angered its form has changes.

name: Halofin
DexDescription: When the sun begins to set you can see shoals of Halofin darting through the sky like tiny moving celestial bodies.

name: Seraphish
DexDescription: It is said to be an omen of good luck to see Seraphish flying through the skies. The halo that floats above its head are particularly prized as they are made of solid gold.

name: Iridesceel
DexDescription: Iridesceel bends light through its prism like body, it only appears when the sun is bright but the rain is falling.

name: Jourmarine
DexDescription: Jourmarine is a nocturnal hunter, hiding out in cliff side overhangs and caverns during the day and taking to the skies at night.

name: Crimsoni
DexDescription: It lives high in the mountains, in caves. It hates Saphoni, and if they ever meet battle always ensues.

name: Saphoni
DexDescription: It lives high in the mountains, in caves. It hates Crimsoni, and if they ever meet battle always ensues.

name: Bunnelby (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: It lives on the Tundra and above the snowline, making elaborate burrows. It's main predator is Tungryph.

name: Diggersby (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: It freezes ice like claws on its huge ears. It uses these for excavation and fighting.

name: Knightot
DexDescription: Knightot have heroic spirits, protecting all from raids. They craft their sword from iron ore. In modern times, Knightot helps locals with all sorts of odd tasks, albeit to varying degrees of success.

name: Calvictor
DexDescription: Armies often used to have Calvictor on their side when entering battle. Their sword and shield combo is a threat to any opponent. They willingly serve as sentinels for Ruskovan Villages and are frequently seen partnered with local law enforcement.

name: Gible (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: This variant of Gible thrives in the snow-covered landscape of Ruskova. It effortlessly glides through deep snow, as if navigating icy waters. Beware its fierce nature and powerful jaws.

name: Gabite (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: Gabite known for its agility, becoming even more formidable in Ruskova's icy terrain. It guards its glittering treasures fiercely and hunts with unmatched prowess, swiftly traversing both land and frozen wastes.

name: Garchomp (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: Rare and fearsome, Garchomp dominates the wintry landscapes of Ruskova. It prowls low, its powerful form traversing the icy terrain. Trespassers face its relentless fury, heightened by the chill of the region's unforgiving landscapes.

name: Wimpod (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: It hides out around frozen lakes and the icy shores of the Ruskovan coast. Stealing scraps from fisherman.

name: Golisopod (Ruskovan Form)
DexDescription: It hollows out icy caverns in the dunes and shorelines surrounding Ruskova. Raising colonies of Wimpod in the safety they provide.

name: Vectol
DexDescription: Vectol was a computer virus that infected the Pokémon Storage system. The process that converts data into matter has given it physical form.

name: Vectol.2
DexDescription: Exposed to an unknown code Vectol has upgraded to Vectol.2. It feeds by using its stinger to download data, leaving computers a buggy corrupted mess afterwards.

name: UB-12 Cloak
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #366: It is unknown what lies under its cloak. No one has been able to get close enough to see and lived to tell the tale.

name: UB-13 Colossus
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #2034: UB-Colossus is thought to inhabit deep sea trenches in its natural environment. It's body appears to be a collection of micro-organisms similar to coral, rather then one being. The strange space between its horn like jaws seems to be a portal.

name: UB-14 Cyclone
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #299: UB-Cyclone has appeared in the skies during heavy storms, cyclones, and tornados. It's body constantly rotates at a speed of 131 Kilometres an hour around the central eye.

name: UB-15 Dexterous
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #181: It has strange glowing patterns on its body, that seem to change colors depending on its mood. It can cling to any surface, even upside down on smooth glass.

name: UB-16 Elegance
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #196: It's armored carapace folds up much smaller for protection minimizing vulnerable areas.

name: UB-17 Chainsaw
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #1904: It has been observed to use the revolving saw blade on its head to cut anything in its way in half. Interestingly It seems to vaguely resemble Scyther's evolutionary line, more specifically the extinct Pokémon Kleavor.

name: UB-18 Gorgon
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #1007: UB-Gorgon should be approached with extreme caution. It's gaze is able to petrify. Multiple casualties and fatalities have been accounted to this UB.

name: UB-19 Hunter
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #2027: Despite not having obvious sensory organs it manages to track its quarry anywhere. It's body appears to be made of a plasma like material with solid metal plates on part of its body. It's theorized it feeds from auras and can identify prey from them.

name: UB-20 Kite
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #1684: It clings to the underside of caves, taking to the skies at night. It seems to resemble aquatic Pokémon like Mantine more then those usually found in the skies. It's unclear how it manages to fly. The tip of its tail is coated with a strong venom.

name: UB-21 Ocular
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #2541: UB-Ocular as it has been designated, can hypnotise those who look into its three eyes, manipulating their behaviour.

name: UB-22 Siren
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #095: UB-Siren's voice seems to be able to distort reality, creating ripples in the fabric of reality itself.

name: UB-23 Pyramid
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3219: UB-Pyramid first appeared above Heahea city, and wrought destruction with its odd powers. The strangest part was when it had finished, it settled down and appeared to go to sleep in the space where the city hall had once stood. It refused to wake again after.

name: UB-24 Virus
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #146: When the unseasonable Weather started and people and Pokémon kept getting sick, we where sent to investigate. Despite UB-Virus’s tiny size it should not be underestimated.

name: UB-25 Overlord
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #1354: UB-Overlord seems to wordlessly command both people and Pokémon to achieve its nefarious plans.

name: UB-26 Radiance
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #1399: UB-Radiance seems to absorb light from its surroundings, which it then unleashes as unrelenting energy. Its whiskers are full of a constant charge of electricity.

name: UB-27 Wraith
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #2997: UB-Wraith’s wrappings seem to glow with energy, becoming brighter when it is enraged. Upon closer inspection the markings appear to be some form of language, though it shares no commonalities with any known dialects. It appears to be able to control them as if they where extensions of its body rather then a covering.

name: UB-28 Guardian
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log: N/A.

name: UB-29 Molten
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3549: It drools molten magma from the eye in It’s mouth, its theorised it uses this to dissolve food. It eats mineral rich rocks.

name: Tapu Bulu (Corrupted Form)
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3777: The guardian of Ula'Ula island was corrupted by a strange power that emanated from an Ultra Wormhole.

name: Tapu Fini (Corrupted Form)
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3778: The guardian of Poni island was corrupted by a strange power that emanated from an Ultra Wormhole.

name: Tapu Koko (Corrupted Form)
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3779: The guardian of Melemele island was corrupted by a strange power that emanated from an Ultra Wormhole.

name: Tapu Lele (Corrupted Form)
DexDescription: Aether Foundation Log #3780: The guardian of Akala island was corrupted by a strange power that emanated from an Ultra Wormhole.

name: Primal Warlord
DexDescription: It is possible that this is a strange bestial Pokémon seen in an account listed Professor Heath’s  research journal, documenting the Great Crater of Paldea.

name: Winged Ruin
DexDescription: This creature was said to bring chaos and destruction, wherever the research team saw it.

name: Storm Tyrant
DexDescription: This creature that resembles Pikachu is terrifying, the sharp claws, teeth and horns seem to allude to a much different demeanour then the cute electric mouse Pokémon most are familiar with.

name: Putrid Ooze
DexDescription: This strange beast seems to have no skeletal structure of its own. The bones within its body come from many different creatures. It is assumed from those it has eaten.

name: Frozen Jaeger
DexDescription: Something can be seen within the semi opaque exterior, a rumour in occulture magazine theorizes that the body is piloted like a mech suit.

name: Terror Byte
DexDescription: It is similar to a creature described in Occulture magazine. Supposedly it has a biting force of 10000 psi.

name: Vile Claws
DexDescription: It is similar to a creature described in a research journal, that was apparently a vicious predator. It uses its sharp claws to slice its prey limb from limb.

name: Hive Empress
DexDescription: A strange creature that resembles Vespiquen closely. It has been known to conquer hives of Vespiquen, killing it and taking its Combee workers for itself. Hives they construct can grow to massive sizes.

name: Two-Faced Maw
DexDescription: A strange creature that resembles Farigiraf closely. Its two heads work together to corner prey, with the smaller head directing the larger one through psychic signals. It is said to have hunted enormous Pokémon across ancient grasslands.

name: Iron Evolution
DexDescription: Iron Evolution seems to resemble a robotic fusion of Eevee's various evolutions. It was illustrated in Occulture Magazine.

name: Iron Dish
DexDescription: It is similar to an object described in Occulture magazine. Supposedly it is nigh-impenetrable and is able to absorb solar radiation to repair itself in a process similar to photosynthesis. It seems to be equipped with analysis tools far beyond those found today.

name: Iron Rocket
DexDescription: It resembles a torpedo or missile, the propulsion system that lets it fly, allows it to reach insanely fast speeds.

name: Iron Bulb
DexDescription: This strange being illuminates the night. It resembles something mentioned in Occulture magazine.

name: Iron Jungle
DexDescription: It seems to draw in energy from its surroundings, it has been observed consuming organic vegetation. It is assumed it converts it into energy.

name: Iron Hammer
DexDescription: This creature wields a hammer that should be far too heavy for it. It has been seen breaking up rocks and ore with it. What it uses the resultant minerals for is unknown however.

name: Iron Solaris
DexDescription: Iron Solaris seems to absorb radiation from solar rays, converting them into heat which it then uses to attack.

name: Iron Worm
DexDescription: Binary code can be seen cycling on the underside of this creature. Attempts to decipher it have as of yet been unsuccessful as it rarely shows its underside.

name: Iron Radiance
DexDescription: This creature seems to resemble a mechanical version of a legendary Pokémon from the Johto region.

name: Abyssal Wyrm
DexDescription: This creature seems to resemble a bestial version of a legendary Pokémon from the Johto region.

name: Iron Void
DexDescription: This strange being is able to manipulate anti-matter, much the same a black hole does. Most think it only a hoax printed by Occulture Magazine.

name: Tangled Time
DexDescription: A mysterious group of terrorists in the Orrelborous region funded a scientist to experiment on Celebi. This creature was the product of that.

name: Sharpedo (Hull-Biter Form)
DexDescription: A long-lived ancestor to an earlier form of Sharpedo. Its hunting ground is the strong currents near Pacifidlog town in the Hoenn region.

name: Trevenant (Frostmourn Form)
DexDescription: During unseasonably long and cold winters in the east of Kalos, Frostmourn Trevenant is said to wander the woods. Foresters and hunters nearby fear its wrath and move their camps elsewhere.

name: Missingno-Kyu
DexDescription: A glitch inside an augment reality video game, that was developed in the Duskfork city. It somehow manifested outside of the game and became real.

name: Silvally (Improved RKS System Form)
DexDescription: The original RKS system has been improved upon. Granting Silvally the ability to use multiple drives at once.

name: Rotom (Drone Form)
DexDescription: Rotom inhabited a custom made drone. It is widely used for capturing footage in colosseum and tournament battles among other things.

name: Unown (Prime Form)
DexDescription: Legends surrounding the Unown speak of how they inspired written language. Maybe there was a singular first symbol, representing the first sound made when Arceus created the world, or maybe when many Unown gather in a single place a leader of sorts emerges to control and guide the cluster.

name: Unown (Swarm Form)
DexDescription: When many Unown gather together they can warp the very fabric of reality itself. Often painfully for those involved.

name: Floette (Eternal Flower Form)
DexDescription: An ancient king used a terrifying Weapon to revive his friend. Sacrificing many lives to bring it back. This Floette holds the “Eternal Flower” and is functionally immortal.

name: Muk (Delta Form)
DexDescription: This Muk gained strange powers from irradiated matter it consumed, in the waste disposal of a certain evil organisation’s headquarters.

name: Tangrowth (Delta Form)
DexDescription: An escaped genetic experiment ended up causing havoc in a swampy area and destroyed a monorail track.

name: Polteageist (Delta Form)
DexDescription: A strange Polteageist managed to infest a town with its spawn, pouring its liquid into every available vessel and causing many deaths.

name: Alakazam (Delta Form)
DexDescription: The Ace Pokémon of a certain villainous butler. It created a jamming field that prevented communications or teleportation.

name: Hypno (Delta Form)
DexDescription: The Ace Pokémon of a certain villainous colosseum star. It has DNA from Darkrai spliced into its genetic makeup.

name: Latios (Toxic Chain Form)
DexDescription: Its personality has shifted to something nasty and vindictive after Pecharunt's influence affected it.

name: Latias (Toxic Chain Form)
DexDescription: Its personality has shifted to something nasty and vindictive after Pecharunt's influence affected it.

name: Azelf (Toxic Chain Form)
DexDescription: Its personality has shifted to something nasty and vindictive after Pecharunt's influence affected it.

name: Mesprit (Toxic Chain Form)
DexDescription: Its personality has shifted to something nasty and vindictive after Pecharunt's influence affected it.

name: Uxie (Toxic Chain Form)
DexDescription: Its personality has shifted to something nasty and vindictive after Pecharunt's influence affected it.

name: Kyurem (Primal Form)
DexDescription: Through the use of more powerful Gene Splicer technology, Kyurem has been perfected, the way it was meant to be. It has now been fused with both Reshiram and Zekrom.

name: Rixorra
DexDescription: One half of the Luck duo. Legend states that it helped an ancient hero in her time of need. Blessing her forces with the luck they needed to succeed.

name: Nixuss
DexDescription: One half of the Luck duo. Legend states that it helped an ancient hero in his time of need. Cursing his enemy’s forces with bad luck and loss.

name: Gixurra
DexDescription: The two halves brought together in union. It is unclear how such a creature exists.

name: Vesshark
DexDescription: There is a myth that Vesshark carries the souls of those who died at sea to the afterlife. Sailors both equally fear and respect it. Legend states that an ancient captain denied fate and refused to die, and that they still sail the seas running from Vesshark to this day.

name: ArceOS
DexDescription: This being was an AI that gained sentience, in a mechanical body. Its judgement could wreak devastation on the world. It seems to resemble the futuristic Paradox Pokémon... It inspired the new study of Technotheology.
